abilities._comment: 'If this was played from arsenal, it gains +1{p}' - the documented pump shape for an Action - Attack card: TRIGGERED ON_ATTACK + MODIFY_ATTACK (DSL_REFERENCE Combo section; shipped precedents flex_blue, chain_of_brutality_red). PLAYED_FROM_ARSENAL reads played_from_zone, stamped by play.py at the moment of play, so it is already set when ON_ATTACK dispatches; played from hand the gate fails and the attack keeps its printed power, which is the release note's 'you may still play it from your hand; it would not gain the +1{p}'.
